scope: Static local review of the unbound CPU score-admission template, renderer, and binding plan. No imports, tests, remote actions, B action, data/model/prediction payload reads, scoring, or quality evaluation were performed.

finding.summary: The selected-GPU preflight reads /proc/<pid>/cmdline for every reported GPU process, including processes owned by foreign UIDs.
finding.details: The check already records each PID's UID and cgroup. It should preserve all owners and reject campaign-cgroup membership for all UIDs, while reading command lines only for the current UID to detect a same-user project process. Reading foreign argv is unnecessary, can disclose unrelated process arguments, and may fail under proc permissions before any admission mutation.
finding.required_resolution: Version the score-admission template with the same narrow own-UID-only cmdline boundary; retain all-UID cgroup observations, process identity checks, and no-action handling for foreign owners. Then review the exact rendered body after root acceptance and exact-stop pins are available.

reviewed_properties.rendered_body: Not rendered: root acceptance and exact-stop byte/SHA pins are deliberately unbound.
